text:
Type: white layered pendant lamp
Use: ambient light over a dining table or a sitting area; dining room, living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, modern
Materials: white plastic overlapping square tiles, white plastic top, white cord and ceiling cup
Colors: bright white, soft warm glow
Shape: bell-shaped shade built from tiers of small overlapping tiles like shingles or feathers, pointed top, hangs on a long cord, textured but light
Feel: soft, playful, airy, sculptural
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pale textiles; Scandinavian or contemporary dining and living rooms

product.name: KVARTR
product.description: Diffused light that provides good general light in the room.
